resources.string: Type or say a task, like “Eccles, open Facebook and post hello everyone”. You will see every step as it happens, and you can stop at any time.

Lets Eccles Agent read what is on screen and perform taps, typing and swipes, but only while you have given it a task. It never reads or acts on apps in your excluded list (banking and payment apps are excluded by default), and it does not read password fields.
Optional. For ADB, connect the phone to a computer once and run: adb tcpip 5555. Then allow the prompt on the phone. This resets after a reboot. Rooted devices can choose Root instead.
